comparison.objective: Replace a toilet roll and reseat a spring spindle in two sockets; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Compressing a telescoping spindle while steering its free end into a socket versus coaxial driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: New roll hangs on a released spindle with both ends seated; candidate requires a locked target opening retained across three cycles.
comparison.reason: Spring-spindle compression and bilateral socket insertion do not test locknut-induced setting disturbance or calibration retention.
